assumptions: registered consistency predicate is deterministic or explicitly modeled
conflict/correction minimality is relative to the frozen constraint set and theory
inclusion-minimal is not minimum-cardinality unless proven
constraint explanation is not automatically causal mechanism
falsifier: Candidate does not improve fully-costed conflict/correction analysis over QuickXplain/MUS-MCS parents, returns a non-conflict or invalid repair, confuses inclusion-minimal with minimum, or turns constraint explanation into unsupported causal authority.
hard_gate_obligations: no causal/scientific authority from conflict set
minimal_counterexamples: delta-debugged failure context is not an inconsistent constraint set
small conflict exists but candidate returns non-minimal superset
minimal correction does not restore satisfiability under target theory
two different MUSes require different repairs
preferred explanation differs from minimum-cardinality explanation
nonmonotone predicate violates assumed conflict-search semantics
constraint conflict is mistaken for real-world causal mechanism
novelty_residual: Evidence-governed integration of minimal conflict and correction analysis into Orion failure/gap/repair routing beyond strongest QuickXplain and MUS/MCS parents, only if a measurable residual remains.
object_description: Given a frozen constraint/model theory and an inconsistent state, compute verified inclusion-minimal conflict explanations and/or minimal correction/relaxation sets before downstream repair, synthesis or pruning.
oracle_or_lower_bound: On small known worlds exhaustively enumerate all subsets to identify every MUS and MCS plus minimum-cardinality representatives. This oracle separates inclusion-minimality, cardinality optimality and completeness of enumeration.
permitted_publication_claim: Scoped constraint-conflict/correction search result only; no causal, scientific or theorem authority beyond the verified constraint theory.
qoi: Paired verified conflict/correction quality and total consistency-check/search cost versus QuickXplain and MUS/MCS parents, with exact minimality and repair-validity semantics.
same_system_ablation: Same inconsistent theories with QuickXplain, MUS/MCS enumeration, failure-condition minimization, and Orion conflict/correction analysis.
scope: frozen consistency theory and preference order
known-world exhaustive oracle available for development/fresh subsets

strongest_parents.justification: Canonical generic parent for inclusion-minimal/preferred conflict explanation over an arbitrary consistency oracle.
Strong parent when the task is exhaustive conflict/correction enumeration rather than one explanation.
Controls whether ordinary failure-context minimization already solves the registered consumer despite weaker constraint semantics.
Small-world oracle provides all MUS/MCSes and minimum-cardinality comparisons.

total_cost_equation: candidate_total = theory_compile + consistency_queries + conflict/correction_search + preference_or_cardinality_selection + repair_validation
